description: Add, move, restyle or remove shapes on a Whiteboard. Shapes are keyed by an id you choose; sending the same id again changes that shape, and null removes it. People with the board open see the change within a second, and it is recorded as yours. Shapes people drew themselves are read with read_board but not changed here.

artifact_id.description: The Artifact id (art_…): the last part of its link, as in bisque.cloud/documents/art_…, /pages/art_… or /artifacts/art_….

shapes.description: Shapes by id (1–64 letters, digits, - or _), each { type, x, y, w, h, z?, color?, text?, frame?, points? }, or null to remove one you drew. type is rect, ellipse, sticky, text, arrow (a line from x,y to x+w,y+h), pen (points is a flat [x0, y0, x1, y1, …] list relative to x,y) or frame (a named area; text is its name). color is ink, gray, red, orange, yellow, green, blue or violet. text is the shape's label. frame puts the shape in the frame with that id. z orders them: higher draws on top. Coordinates are board pixels, y grows downward; a sticky is about 200×200. At most 500 a call.

name: edit_board
title: Draw on a Whiteboard
